title: The case for AI degrowth
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), as it currently unfolds, is incompatible with a sustainable transformation of the economy, which arguably requires degrowth. AI is the growth paradigm reborn — built on enclosed commons, powered by fossil energy, and driven by a competitive logic that makes precaution structurally impossible. Limits to AI growth are not technophobia; they are our best chance for a liveable future for all.
abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）作为目前的发展模式，与经济的可持续转型相悖，后者或许需要退休。AI 是增长范式的重生——建立在封闭的公共领域，依赖化石能源，并由竞争逻辑驱动，这使得谨慎在结构上成为不可能。AI 的增长限制并非技术恐惧，而是所有人类可居住未来的最佳机会。
